items.text: – Es saku, ka Ameroka apstiprinājusi, ka Irāna kodolprogrammu apturējusi. Vai tas nozīmē, ka būs karš vai nebūs?
items.q: Maman mispronounces foreign words on purpose, all through the book. Would an elderly Latvian speaker say America as 'Ameroka'? If not, how?

items.text: – Ohooo. Tad valstis noteikti bijušas tuvu cita citai. Kad bija Bam zemestrīce?
items.q: Maman, watching tsunami news, guesses how earthquakes spread. Does it sound like her?

items.text: – Ir pienācis pasaules gals. Bibi paaudze mēdza teikt: kad pienāks pasaules gals, zeme arvien trīcēs.
items.q: Maman repeats what the old folks said about the end of days. Does it sound like her?

items.text: – Hmm, tad arī es saku, ka man sirds kļūst smaga. Ļaujiet man mazliet aiziet pie savām draudzenēm.
items.q: Maman says she also feels low and wants to visit friends. Does it sound like her?

items.text: Nana-pesar-jan, tev tiešām jārūpējas par to, ko ēd. Ēd labas lietas. Tādas, kas dara stipru. Tikai ēd labi. Pārējais man vienalga.
items.q: Maman urges her son abroad to eat well. Does it sound like a caring mother?

items.text: – Mm-hm, viņš ir ļoti, ļoti mainījies. Viņš ir kļuvis tik tievs un tumšs.
items.q: Maman says a man has grown thin and dark in the face. Does it sound like a mother talking?
before: – Ak, tiešām? Tātad viņš ir ļoti mainījies.

items.text: – Ak vai, Nini pēkšņi nāk miegs. Esmu nomodā kopš rīta, neizgulējusies.
items.q: Maman, who calls herself Nini, says she is suddenly sleepy. Does it sound natural?
before: Maman cieši aizver acis un saka:

items.text: – Ah, tiklīdz pasaki, lai viņš ko atnes, viņu it kā strāva trāpa.
items.q: Maman complains that her son hates running errands. Does it sound like her?

items.text: Tajā laikā man bija četri gadi. Viņa vienmēr mani atrada četras reizes. Tagad man ir seši.
items.q: A six-year-old tells this. Does it sound like a small child?

items.text: Tas ir tik garšīgs. Haaj Kazem veikals arī ir garšīgs.
items.q: A six-year-old says the corner shop itself tastes good. Does this sound like a small child's logic?

items.text: Tas bija tālu. Līdz pat otram pasaules galam. Varbūt nē. Bet tas bija tālu.
items.q: A six-year-old describes a long walk. Does it sound like a small child?

items.text: Maman teica, ka Dievs ir debesīs. Debesis arī ir zilas.
items.q: A six-year-old explains why he loves blue. Does it sound like a small child?

items.text: Šo daļu es nekad neapguvu. Viņš vienmēr teica vissvarīgākais... kaut kas... uzdevumā.
items.q: A six-year-old admits he never learned his big brother's words. Does it sound like a small child?
before: – Misijas trešā posma beigas. Šeit ir vissvarīgākais ...

items.text: – Šorīt es gāju pagalmā. Maman teica, ka esmu gudrs.
items.q: A four-year-old proudly tells his brother this. Does it sound like a small child?

items.text: – Labi, uzber mazāk. Bet ne daudz mazāk. Mazliet mazāk.
items.q: A small boy bargains with his mother over salt on his plums. Does it sound like a small child?
Ghassem, playing commander, warns with a click of the tongue. Does 'tsk-tsk' read as that sound?
before: Es vienmēr daru to, ko Maman saka. Es arī darīju to, ko Ghassem teica. Viņš vienmēr teica:
